## Purpose
`/mcp`: the registered MCP servers. It covers registration, health check-all, bulk remove and a get-started guide (Register, Discover, Try & use).

## Responsibilities
`McpIndexPage`:
- reads `mcpApi.servers`;
- `McpServerCard`s;
- `RegisterMcpDialog`;
- `healthCheck` ("Health check complete.");
- bulk `removeServer`;
- `GetStarted`;
- the empty state "No MCP servers registered".

Titled "MCP Servers — Agentic AI Design Patterns".
